title: Best Damn Google Autocomplete Scraper input
description: Enter one or more seed keywords. Each seed keyword (including all of its expansions) is one billable result; keywords that fail because of network or rate-limit errors are reported for free.

keywords.title: Seed keywords
keywords.description: One seed keyword per line (or a JSON array of strings). Google Autocomplete works best with partial phrases such as `best crm for` or `how to start a podcast`. Duplicates are removed automatically.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code (`gl` parameter) that controls which country's suggestions are returned, e.g. `us`, `gb`, `de`, `in`, `br`.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language code (`hl` parameter), e.g. `en`, `de`, `es`, `pt-BR`, `zh-CN`. Use the language your target audience searches in.

expandAlphabet.title: Expand with a-z
expandAlphabet.description: Also query `<keyword> a` to `<keyword> z` (26 extra requests per seed keyword). The most effective way to discover long-tail suggestions.

expandQuestions.title: Expand with question words
expandQuestions.description: Also query `who <keyword>`, `what <keyword>`, `when`, `where`, `why`, `how`, `can`, `is`, `are`, `does`, `will` (11 extra requests per seed keyword). Great for mining question-style keywords.

expandPrepositions.title: Expand with prepositions
expandPrepositions.description: Also query `<keyword> for`, `with`, `without`, `near`, `to`, `vs`, `like`, `versus` (8 extra requests per seed keyword).

expandNumbers.title: Expand with numbers
expandNumbers.description: Also query `<keyword> 0` to `<keyword> 9` (10 extra requests per seed keyword). Useful for years, versions and top-10 style queries.

maxSuggestionsPerKeyword.title: Max suggestions per keyword
maxSuggestionsPerKeyword.description: Stop collecting for a seed keyword once this many unique suggestions have been found. Remaining expansion and depth-2 requests for that keyword are skipped.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: `1` queries only the seed keyword (plus enabled expansions). `2` additionally re-queries every suggestion found at depth 1 once, which multiplies the number of requests but uncovers many more long-tail phrases.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many suggest requests to run in parallel for the current seed keyword. Keep it low (the default is 3) to avoid rate limiting; seed keywords are always processed one after another.

maxRetries.title: Retries per request
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry a failed suggest request (with exponential back-off) before reporting it as failed.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Route requests through Apify Proxy if Google starts rate-limiting the datacenter IP addresses used by the platform. Proxy usage is billed by Apify separately from this Actor's per-keyword price.
